premise_correction: SESSION_FINAL_2026-08-06 declared the axis closed on the claim that the bottleneck is output dispersion at fixed wind speed. Falsified 2026-08-07: a leakage-free cross-group measured-wind oracle scores 0.782630 and a zero-parameter physics map scores 0.869922 on the same local protocol. The binding constraint is NWP -> hub-height wind.
local_protocol: pooled dev-2023 Q2+Q3+Q4, official metric once, single policy (verified: M102_TOP100 T0.5_G1.5 = 0.6298962296336882)

stages.name: 예측문제의 목적 파악
evidence: Total = 0.5*(1-NMAE) + 0.5*FICR; FICR is an actual-weighted step reward with a +-6%/+-8% band
deployed prediction is an ACTION maximising expected settlement, not a conditional mean

stages.name: 데이터 특성
evidence: VESTAS power columns are time-scrambled (corr vs own ws = 0.02) -> unusable
VESTAS ws/wd valid (hourly mean vs label g1 corr 0.9273)
UNISON power valid; 10-min SUM reproduces the hourly label (corr 0.9966, MAE 294 kWh)
each target hour has exactly ONE forecast (no lagged-ensemble available)

stages.name: 데이터 정밀분석
evidence: clean cross-group oracle 0.782630; leaky own-group oracle 0.876846 (leak = +0.094)
fitted power curve per group; physics-only pc*cap = 0.869922, MAE(cf) 0.0365-0.0420
NWP -> measured wind RMSE 1.49-1.78 m/s; NWP -> pc MAE(cf) 0.089-0.132
physics residual r = actual_cf - pc: median 0.000, IQR [-0.019,+0.008] -> clean-operation sigma is ~0.03, INSIDE the +-0.06 settlement band
heavy left tail: r<-0.10 & pc>0.15 occurs in 7.1%/7.4%/8.8% of hours (g1/g2/g3)
group-3 UNISON SCADA gives DIRECT downtime: corr(n_turbines_down, r) = -0.7854; mean r = +0.005 / -0.111 / -0.236 / -0.464 for 0 / 1 / 2 / 3+ turbines down
label = physics x availability; availability is a heavy-tailed multiplicative shock on ~8% of hours

stages.name: 평가지표의 이해
evidence: FICR loss is concentrated at capacity factor 0.4-0.8 (0.33 of 0.59 total loss); hit4 only 0.17-0.24 there
deployed model is biased +0.126 at cf 0.1-0.2 and -0.099 at cf 0.9-1.0

nodes.name: 가용성 분리 학습 (outage-aware target decomposition)
nodes.hypothesis: 라벨은 physics x availability 이고 availability 충격은 예보시점에 예측 불가능하다. 원 라벨에 회귀하면 조건부 평균이 아래로 끌려가 밴드 적중을 잃는다. 청정운전 행만으로 학습하고 정지확률은 별도 혼합성분으로 두면 행동이 청정값으로 올라가 FICR 이 오른다.
nodes.measured_ceiling: 동일 입력(측정 pc)에서 물리맵 0.869922 vs LGBM 조건부평균 재적합 0.838745 = +0.031157. 이것이 이 노드의 상한이다.
nodes.gate: pooled dev-2023 로컬 total 이 같은 특징집합의 대조군 대비 +0.005 이상 개선
nodes.risk: 청정행 필터가 고풍속 정지(cut-out)까지 지워 상단 분포를 왜곡할 수 있음

defects_found.desc: v3 decision layer applies temperature to a UNIFORM sample weight vector, so sharpening is a no-op (all T give identical score). FICR 0.3574 vs deployed 0.4062. Must histogram the predictive samples into bins before sharpening.
